# React reference

Learning the controls? Read the single [React developer guide](../developer-guide/README.md).
This index is for looking up an exact contract after a lesson.

| Reference | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [DataTable](data-table.md) | Supplied rows, props/defaults, typed columns/actions, slots, sorting, sizing, semantics |
| [QueryTable](query-table.md) | Required raw identity/projection, state slots, `queryTableState`, shared composition/animation |
| [Modal](modal.md) | Controlled open/close, refs, focus, dismissal, lazy/SSR behavior, scoped portal themes |
| [Bindings and hooks](bindings.md) | Structural client binding, query/view state, raw identity, projection, motion |
| [Styles and tokens](styles.md) | Canonical CSS tokens, light defaults, scoped themes and row flashes |
| [Core](core.md) | Renderer-free clients/streams, normalized results, subscriptions, state helpers, limits, errors |
| [Server client](server-client.md) | Optional REST/read DTOs, wire adapters/templates, transports/auth, direct lifecycle |
| [Server provider](server-provider.md) | React Server convenience, connection options/defaults, ownership, inspection hooks |
| [Public entrypoints](exports.md) | Complete symbol/import map, hosting responsibilities, SSR/import boundaries |
| [Migration history](migration.md) | Earlier import and behavior changes, explicitly historical |
| [Validation](validation.md) | Package/consumer/browser gates, compatibility evidence, pending human acceptance |
| [Installation](installation.md) | Learning distribution, preview availability, optional pnpm setup |

The first nine references have **one authoring source beside the implementation**.
`DataTable.md`, `QueryTable.md`, and `Modal.md` sit beside their `.tsx` files.
Binding and adapter directories have their own README; generic core and CSS
references stay with core and styles, not mixed into React render/ref contracts.
Each generated copy links its authoring source.

To edit a reference in a checkout, change that source, run `npm run docs:sync`,
and commit both source and generated Markdown. `npm run docs:check`, the build,
and installed-document checks reject stale copies or broken local links.
The references stay within the installed React package. The complete guide
and runnable helpers are in the separate learning kit; it includes its own
generated reference copies for offline reading.

[Co-located authoring source](https://github.com/drasi-project/drasi-ui/blob/main/packages/react/docs/reference/README.md). This packaged copy is checked byte-for-byte, including its rewritten links.
